Two capabilities, one private app

From the AudioGuard project proposal: real-time and offline verification of voices, with all processing performed locally on the device.

1

Live call analysis

Sliding 4-second windows with smoothing give a stable confidence score during a call, with a clear warning when needed.

2

File and voice-note check

Analyse saved audio or forwarded voice notes. A per-segment timeline shows exactly which seconds look suspicious.

3

Honest confidence bands

Likely genuine, Uncertain or Likely AI-generated. Never “safe”. The user keeps the final decision.

4

Urdu and language independent

Acoustic features only, no speech-to-text, so it works for Urdu and other low-resource languages.

5

Privacy first

Audio never leaves the device. No account, no server, no storage of recordings.

6

Robust by design

Planned noise, reverberation and codec augmentation so phone-call audio stays reliable.

How it works

The modular pipeline from the proposal.

1 InputMicrophone or audio file
2 Pre-processResample, normalise, frame
3 FeaturesLog-mel, MFCC / LFCC
4 DetectorCompact model (RawNet2 / AASIST / LCNN candidates)
5 ScoringSmoothing, hysteresis, bands
6 OutputScore, warning, advice

آڈیو گارڈ آواز کے صوتی نقوش دیکھتا ہے، الفاظ نہیں۔ اس لیے یہ اردو اور دوسری زبانوں میں بھی اے آئی سے بنی آوازیں پہچان سکتا ہے۔

Evaluation plan

Measured with Equal Error Rate, accuracy, latency and model size under clean, noisy and compressed conditions, including Urdu test samples. Training data: ASVspoof 2019, WaveFake, In-the-Wild and a project Urdu set.

Scope

Included

Acoustic detection, live calls, file verification, confidence warnings, fully local processing.

Not included

Speaker identification, truthfulness of content, cloud processing, music or video deepfakes, app-store release.
